summary: Executed backend pytest regression suite (12 tests) against public origin and ran end-to-end UI checks across desktop/mobile including role switch, field creation, advisory, expert review, WhatsApp simulation, map attribution, offline queue attempt, and build checks.

integration_issues.issue: Manual sync button was not consistently available after reconnect in one run; queue may auto-sync immediately, making deterministic manual-sync validation flaky.
Console repeatedly logs hydration error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from emergent runtime wrapper insertion; functional flow passes but runtime HTML validity warning persists.

action_items: Investigate hydration warning from emergent runtime wrapping dynamic option text with <span> in select options.
Stabilize or document expected offline queue behavior on reconnect (auto-sync vs manual sync visibility) for deterministic UX/testing.
Run a dedicated pass for OTP expiry timing boundary and recording-permission-denied UX path (not fully covered in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth credentials guide file /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but has no usable test credentials content; auth tests used documented demo OTP/phones from review request and env.
Console runtime warning appears consistently on select option rendering; although source TSX uses plain text children, deployed runtime injects invalid descendants causing hydration warnings.
seed_data_creation: Created only TEST_* API records during tests (fields, advisories, uploads, reviews); no seed fixtures modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is reusable at /app/backend/app/tests/test_sahaayak_api.py and currently green (12/12). Full UI flow passed for add-field, advisory generation, WhatsApp terminal failure label, expert review, mobile role switch, and map attribution. Offline sync/manual button behavior was inconsistent once after reconnect and needs deterministic recheck. MOCKED providers confirmed in-app: OTP SMS, vision, transcription, weather, WhatsApp delivery, local private storage.
rca of the issue: Hydration warning RCA: console traces point to https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js injecting dynamic wrapper span nodes within option tags for select fields (advisory field selector and review source selector). This produces HTML invalid-child warnings and hydration risk despite successful business flow. Offline sync inconsistency RCA (probable): syncQueue auto-runs on online event in Layout useEffect, so queue panel with manual sync button can disappear before scripted/manual click.
